title: Regenerative Biomaterials
summary: This Edited Volume, Regenerative Biomaterials - Emerging Biomaterial Solutions to Aid Tissue Regeneration , is a collection of peer-reviewed chapters that offers a comprehensive overview of recent developments in tissue regeneration, including novel biomaterials derived from sustainable sources. The book comprises single chapters authored by various researchers and edited by an expert in tissue regeneration research. All chapters are complete in themselves but united under a common research study topic. This publication aims to provide an overview of recent research by international authors and to introduce new research directions for further development.
